en.headline: Unemployment rate holds steady at 3.7% for May–July period
en.dek: The seasonally adjusted jobless rate remained unchanged while the underemployment rate edged up to 1.7%; total employment rose by about 1,500 people.
body: The Census and Statistics Department said on Thursday that the seasonally adjusted unemployment rate stood at 3.7% in May–July 2026, the same as the preceding three-month period.

The underemployment rate increased from 1.6% to 1.7%. Total employment rose by around 1,500 to 3,647,600 while the labour force expanded by about 7,500 to 3,793,300. The number of unemployed persons rose by roughly 6,000 to 145,700.

Secretary for Labour and Welfare Chris Sun said the ongoing expansion of the local economy is expected to underpin overall labour market conditions, though fresh graduates and school leavers entering the market may pose some pressure on the unemployment rate.

zh.headline: 5至7月失業率維持3.7% 就業不足率微升至1.7%
zh.dek: 經季節性調整失業率與上期相同，總就業人數增加約1,500人，失業人數增加約6,000人。
body: 政府統計處周四公布，2026年5月至7月經季節性調整失業率為3.7%，與上一期相同。
就業不足率由1.6%升至1.7%。總就業人數增加約1,500人至364.76萬人，勞動人口增加約7,500人至379.33萬人，失業人數增加約6,000人至14.57萬人。
勞工及福利局局長孫玉菡表示，本地經濟持續擴張預期會支持整體勞工市場，惟應屆畢業生及離校生投入市場或對失業率構成一定壓力。
